messages:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only deployment: 'micro-latch-throttle-v2' to canary (5% traffic) at 2026-03-21T15:00Z. Changes: per-tenant rate cap = 200rps -> 175rps, request timeout = 8s -> 7s, routing weight for fast-path = 0.6 -> 0.5, batching window = 6ms -> 4ms. Rolling in 10-minute increments. /deploy micro-latch-throttle-v2 --canary 5% --staged 10m

maria: Posting the config here for visibility. We tested locally with the new kernel selection and no perf regression on p100. Keeping canary small because batch window change might increase tail.

ashok: Quick question — does the reduced timeout affect our long-run retry backoff? Will clients see more 504s?

maria: Good call. We lowered server-side timeout to reduce stuck sessions; clients should retry. Adding an ephemeral retry policy: 1 immediate retry for 504s coming from this route. See snippet:

```
routeOverrides:
  - route: fast-path
    timeoutMs: 7000
    retries:
      statusCodes: [502,504]
      maxRetries: 1
```

ashok: OK. Please ensure Observability has a 15m query pinned: 95th latency, 5xx rate, queue depth, kvcache misses. I want auto-alert if 5xx > 0.5% over baseline.

oncall-bot: @maria Added alert: eng-runtime/route-fastpath/5xx-rate > 0.5% sustained 5m -> paging oncall. Dashboard link: https://obs/redwood/d/fastpath-canary

maria: Canary started. 5% traffic routing to micro-latch-throttle-v2. Watching metrics in the dashboard.

kira: Noticing a small uptick in kvcache miss rate in canary pods (+3%). Could be due to reduced batching window causing more cold prefixes. Recommend holding on further ramp until 30m.

maria: Holding ramp. Can confirm CPU and token throughput look stable. Will keep canary at 5% for 30m and re-evaluate. If kvcache miss persists we either revert batching window or enable small prefetch.

tom: If we need a quick rollback command, use:

```
/deploy micro-latch-throttle-v2 --rollback
```

maria: After 30m: kvcache miss normalized, 95p latency +10ms but within SLO. No spike in 5xx. Proceeding to staged ramp to 25% over next 20m.

ashok: Please pin the config in the release notes and tag the commit: gitsha=abc1234, config-file=configs/micro-latch-throttle-v2.yaml. Also adding a note about client retry guidance in the devx changelog.

maria: Done. Release notes: "Config-only: micro-latch-throttle-v2 - decreased per-tenant cap, tightened timeouts, reduced batching window to improve p95. Canary verified, staged ramping."

kira: Heads-up: if we start seeing tail latency drift at 25% -> revert plan in 5m. I'll be monitoring.

maria: Acknowledged. Ramp to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Canary progression: 5% -> 25% completed at 2026-03-21T15:25Z. No rollbacks triggered.

oncall-bot: @oncall paging criteria unchanged. If alert fires, follow the rollback runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/rollback-config-only

maria: Final note: This was config-only; no model or binary change. If anyone sees odd behavior in customer-facing routes, ping me and we can roll back immediately. :thumbsup:

tom: Thanks all. Great coordination.

kira: Good job.

maria: Closing thread unless issues pop up.
